craft_notes: Sthāyin: concession — mercy rite. Rows: promise then audience. Read aloud: gentle decree.

lines: Though no circle ever seen, the feast-days kept by image-rite
within a year bear sons'-rite fruit, no dusk-rites needed.
So for the aged, the lovers, wives — when power falls, the master teaches.
l4.sanskrit_cite: adṛṣṭamaṇḍalo 'pi mūrtiyāgena parvadināni pūjayan varṣād eva putrakoktaṃ phalam eti vinā saṃdhyānuṣṭhānādibhiḥ iti vṛddhānāṃ bhogināṃ strīṇāṃ vidhir ayam śaktipāte sati upadeṣṭavyo guruṇā
